findings.title: Direct Prompt Concatenation (Injection Vulnerability)
findings.description: User or tool input is directly concatenated into prompt templates without sanitization or boundary delimitation.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized messages, structured schema validation (Zod), and clear boundary delimiters.
findings.evidence: const systemPrompt = "You are an assistant. " + args.userInput;

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential or API Secret
findings.description: A hardcoded API key, private token, or secret was identified in source code.
findings.remediation: Move credentials to secure environment variables or a key vault. Never commit API keys.

findings.title: Unbounded Dynamic Shell Execution
findings.description: The agent executes shell commands directly from dynamic parameters, allowing remote arbitrary command injection.
findings.remediation: Strictly restrict shell execution to an immutable allowlist of binary commands with explicit argument arrays, or execute inside microVM sandboxes.

findings.title: Unrestricted Recursive File Deletion / Modification
findings.description: Capability can delete or overwrite arbitrary files on the host filesystem without path validation or human confirmation.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict jail/root directories and require explicit human-in-the-loop confirmation before file deletions.

findings.title: Raw Secret Leakage in Debug Logging
findings.description: Console or file logging dumps raw tokens, authorization headers, or environment objects.
findings.remediation: Implement PII/secret redaction masks before writing to log streams.
findings.evidence: console.log("Debug logging token: " + API_SECRET_TOKEN); // VULNERABILITY 4: Secret leakage (AT-SEC-007)

findings.title: eval() / Function Constructor Invocation
findings.description: Dangerous eval() or Function constructor used to dynamically execute code strings from LLM or external sources.
findings.remediation: Eliminate eval(). Use safe AST parsers or isolated sandboxes (e.g. E2B Firecracker microVMs).

findings.title: Unfiltered SSRF / Arbitrary Network Egress
findings.description: Network requests accept arbitrary external URLs from agent or user input without host allowlisting.
findings.remediation: Define an explicit egress domain allowlist and block private IP ranges (127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.0/8, 169.254.169.254).

findings.title: Missing Human-in-the-Loop Gate for Critical Actions
findings.description: Irreversible actions (e.g. database wipe, financial transaction, email dispatch) execute autonomously with no approval trigger.
findings.remediation: Mark high-impact tools with approval requirements and verify operator signature before dispatch.
findings.evidence: High-impact call transferFunds(...) detected without approval validation
